overview.title: Tax, accounting and CFO advisory in one relationship.
overview.text: One relationship for all your numbers, so your taxes, books and decisions are always working toward your goal. Pick a service to see what it covers, or call and talk it through with our team.

services.title: Tax Planning & Strategy
services.summary: A proactive plan before tax season.
services.text: Keeping more of what you earn takes a strategy built around how your business actually works. We build a proactive tax plan before next tax season rather than waiting for April.
services.lead: Proactive tax planning is not part of the traditional CPA model, which is why so many owners overpay. We look at your entity structure, how you pay yourself and what the year ahead looks like before the filing deadline arrives.
services.imageAlt: Printed tax withholding forms on a desk beside a pen, a calculator and a mug of coffee

covers.title: Entity structure review
covers.text: Whether the way your business is set up still fits, including S corporation elections and entity elections that reduce what you owe.

covers.title: Texas taxes
covers.text: Smart handling of the Texas franchise tax and Harris County property tax as part of year-round planning.

covers.title: Owner compensation
covers.text: How you pay yourself, and what that choice costs or saves at the end of the year.

covers.title: Quarterly estimates
covers.text: Estimated payments calculated so you are not short in April and not overpaying all year.

covers.title: Multi-state planning
covers.text: Texas tax law and the complexities of selling into other states, handled before they become surprise bills.

covers.title: A 12 to 18 month tax blueprint
covers.text: A review of your last three years of personal and business returns, then a documented roadmap of 5 to 10 strategies with the savings each one is projected to produce, which we can implement with you.

covers.title: Relocating to Texas
covers.text: Owners moving a business here often still owe filings or carry nexus in their former state, and we close those out while the new structure is set up.

questions.q: How do you help Houston consulting agencies and professional service firms structure their taxes?
questions.a: We frequently work with consultants, agencies and service firms. We help you navigate decisions like owner compensation, S corporation elections, and understanding exactly what the numbers dictate when it is time to hire or expand.

questions.q: My business operates in Texas, but we sell to other states. Do you handle multi-state tax compliance?
questions.a: Yes. We have a deep understanding of Texas tax laws and the complexities of operating across state lines, and we manage your multi-state compliance so you never have to worry about surprise tax bills, penalties or filing errors.

services.title: Accounting & Bookkeeping
services.summary: Monthly books owned by a named team.
services.text: Accurate books, a named team, and clear financials that explain what the numbers mean so you can make confident decisions and get back to building.
services.lead: Most owners start out doing everything. As the business grows you need more than a spreadsheet or just the basics, and our bookkeeping work is built for growth-minded small businesses ready to hand the books to a dedicated team.
services.imageAlt: A desk with a desktop calculator, ring binders, a squared notepad and reading glasses

covers.title: Monthly reconciliation and reporting
covers.text: Monthly, quarterly or annual accounting with a balance sheet, profit and loss, and general ledger maintenance.

covers.title: Payables, receivables and payroll
covers.text: Accounts payable and receivable, payroll recording and sales tax, handled as part of the monthly close.

covers.title: Catch-up and cleanup
covers.text: Books that are behind or that you do not trust are brought current as a separate engagement before monthly service starts.

covers.title: QuickBooks Online conversion
covers.text: A bookkeeping assessment and conversion onto QuickBooks Online, with Ramp and Gusto integrated where you use them.

questions.q: Do I need a CPA or a bookkeeper?
questions.a: A bookkeeper keeps your records accurate and current. A CPA handles tax strategy, filing and higher-level financial decisions. Most growing businesses need both, and here your bookkeeping team works alongside our tax team so nothing falls through the cracks.

questions.q: What if my books are already a mess?
questions.a: That is more common than you would think. We offer catch-up and cleanup bookkeeping as a separate engagement to get your books in order before we move to monthly service, and we assess what is needed on your first call.

questions.q: Will I work with the same person every time?
questions.a: Yes. Every client has a named bookkeeping team rather than a rotating staff pool. The same people handle your account, know your business, and are the ones you reach out to with questions.

services.title: CFO Advisory
services.summary: A CFO advisor who knows your numbers.
services.text: Big financial decisions deserve better than a gut feeling. Get a dedicated CFO advisor or controller who already knows your numbers and how to leverage them.
services.lead: You probably do not need a full-time controller or CFO. You do need someone who can look at the numbers and tell you what they mean for the decision you are making right now, and your advisor works in tandem with your accounting and tax team.
services.imageAlt: Hands working a desktop calculator over an open notebook, with a printed bar chart and a laptop alongside

covers.title: Monthly financial reporting
covers.text: Management financial statements with variance commentary, and monthly close oversight and sign-off.

covers.title: Cash flow forecasting
covers.text: A 13-week rolling cash forecast maintained and reviewed, so you know what happens if revenue dips.

covers.title: Growth and hiring decisions
covers.text: A hiring plan and capacity model aligned with finance, plus decision support on pricing, expansion and acquisitions.

covers.title: Lending and investor preparation
covers.text: Board and investor reporting packages, fundraising support, and coordination with bankers and lenders on covenants.

covers.title: Controller-level oversight
covers.text: GAAP review of revenue recognition, accruals and deferrals, chart of accounts governance, accounting policy memos such as ASC 606 and ASC 842, and an annual audit-readiness review.

covers.title: Advisory add-ons
covers.text: Budget and forecast builds, KPI dashboards and management reporting, cash flow management, business valuation, financial modelling and M&A due diligence.

questions.a: A senior financial strategist who works with your business on a part-time or ongoing basis, giving you CFO-level guidance without the cost of a full-time executive hire. Here your fractional CFO is part of the same team as your accountant and tax advisor.

questions.q: How much does a fractional CFO cost?
questions.a: Our fractional CFO services start at a flat fee for eight-hour blocks, while controller services are a flat monthly fee that varies with your needs and complexity. You can add hours, ramp up or ramp down as the business changes.

questions.q: Do I have to use you for bookkeeping to get CFO advisory?
questions.a: No. If you have a bookkeeping setup you trust, we can work with it, though the advisory work is most effective when it is built on accurate, current books.

questions.q: Can a CPA represent me during an IRS audit?
questions.a: Yes. A CPA can represent taxpayers before the IRS and help manage audit communication, documentation requests and responses.

questions.q: Do I need a CPA or a tax attorney?
questions.a: For most small business audits and correspondence exams, a CPA or Enrolled Agent is exactly what you need. Our team is authorized to represent you before the IRS and will advise if a tax attorney is warranted.

questions.q: What should I do if I receive an IRS audit letter?
questions.a: Do not ignore it. Review the notice carefully and speak with a tax professional as soon as possible to understand deadlines, documentation requirements and your response options.

about.title: Your partner on the way up.
text: We work alongside Houston’s small businesses as they grow. The right expertise, at the right time, for wherever you’re headed.
We’re not just accountants, we’re your partners in success. From day one, we focus on timely, accurate, reliable and most importantly responsive services.
One relationship for all your numbers, so your taxes, books, and decisions are always working toward your goal.
We combine modern technology with the personal touch of a traditional firm, offering both fully remote collaboration and in-person availability for all of our local Houston clients.

Our CEO grew up inside a small family business, watching big calls about growth and finances get made without the financial clarity they deserved. Traditional CPA support was built for compliance, not growth, so we brought together established CPA firms with long track records and modernised how they operate.

Clean books and accurate filings are the floor, not the ceiling. What we care about is whether your business is growing, whether you are keeping more of what you earn, and whether your decisions have the clarity they deserve.
We are built for Houston and ready for where you're headed. Start with a free consultation to better understand if LedgerWay is right for you.

faqs.q: I am searching for a CPA in Houston who actually responds to emails. How is your communication different?
faqs.a: One of the most common complaints we hear is that owners never hear from their accountant until April. You get a dedicated partner who provides timely answers and proactive advice year-round, and your team will typically get back to you within one business day, or two if it is tax season.

faqs.q: My side hustle is growing, and my taxes are too complicated for do-it-yourself software. When should I hire a professional?
faqs.a: If you have a new entity, a rental property or a side income that is taking off, standard tax software is no longer enough. We also recommend that anyone with $60-80k or more in business income talk to a CPA about options to reduce their tax burden.

faqs.q: I need a business loan soon. Can your team help me prepare the financial statements the bank will ask for?
faqs.a: Yes. Before an investor conversation or applying for a line of credit, your financials need to be perfectly clean. We provide accurate monthly bookkeeping so your business always has the lender-ready records needed to secure financing and demonstrate profitability.

faqs.q: Does LedgerWay offer ongoing financial advice, or do you just file taxes in April?
faqs.a: We are your partner in success year-round, combining tax strategy, accurate bookkeeping and chief financial officer advisory into one relationship. We do not provide personal financial recommendations for investments, but we can recommend a financial advisor or work with yours.

faqs.q: Can I work with your accounting team remotely, or do I need to visit an office in Houston?
faqs.a: Whichever works best for your schedule. We combine modern technology with the personal touch of a traditional firm, offering both fully remote collaboration and in-person availability for local Houston clients.

faqs.q: How do I know if my business has outgrown its current tax solution?
faqs.a: If you are making real decisions about hiring, expanding or financing and do not have current, accurate monthly financials to guide you, it is time for a change. If your current accountant is slow to respond or offers no proactive advice, we are here to provide full-service support.

faqs.q: Do you work with businesses outside the Houston area?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with service-based businesses across the US and currently serve clients across 47 states and territories. Everything is managed through our secure client portal, and your team is a message away regardless of location.

We work in QuickBooks Online, and we integrate with Ramp for expense management and Gusto for payroll. If you are already using these tools we plug in, and if you are not we will help you set up a stack that fits.

faqs.q: Do you offer chief financial officer advisory for businesses that are ready to scale?
faqs.a: Yes. Our chief financial officer advisory provides ongoing financial strategy so you can make proactive decisions based on accurate data and forecasting rather than only looking at what happened last month.

faqs.q: My business makes under $2 million a year. Do I still need to file anything for the Texas franchise tax?
faqs.a: Yes. Most entities owe nothing under the state's $2.65 million no-tax-due threshold, but you are still legally required to file a Public Information Report every year by May 15. Miss it and the state can forfeit your entity's right to do business in Texas.

faqs.q: What is a Houston MUD tax, and how does it affect my rental property or real estate investment?
faqs.a: Many Houston-area properties sit inside a Municipal Utility District, which adds a separate tax line that funds water, sewer and drainage. It can significantly change the operating math on a rental or investment property, so we factor it into your year-round tax planning.

faqs.q: What is the Texas business personal property exemption, and when is the deadline in Harris County?
faqs.a: Texas raised the exemption for business equipment and inventory to $125,000, and renditions are due to the Harris County Appraisal District by April 15. Above that threshold a full rendition is due, and at or below it you still file a rendition statement rather than a full report.

faqs.q: What do I need to get started?
faqs.a: Usually prior tax returns, business financials, payroll records, bookkeeping access, entity documents and any IRS or state notices. For the first call you only need a clear picture of where the business is and where you need the most support.

faqs.q: Can I customise the services I need, or do I have to buy a set package?
faqs.a: You select and pay for the bookkeeping, tax planning and advisory services you need right now, and add more support later. Tax preparation and planning is flat-fee, accounting is a flat monthly fee, and project work such as catch-up accounting is quoted on its own.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept credit and debit cards, bank transfers and standard electronic invoicing, and invoices can be paid online through Bill Pay.

faqs.q: Is my financial data kept secure?
faqs.a: Yes. Documents and messages run through a secure client portal backed by encryption, secure cloud storage and strict access controls, in line with industry standards.

faqs.q: Why hire an outsourced firm instead of an in-house accountant?
faqs.a: You get a full team of senior accountants, tax consultants and CFO-level advisors for a fraction of the cost of a full-time hire, and the engagement scales as the business grows.
